SELECT a.instance_id FROM t_cruise_point_instance a WHERE a.cruise_id IN ( SELECT inspection_id FROM t_robot_inspection WHERE ( SELECT robot_id FROM t_robot_info WHERE robot_code = #{robotCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )) AND a.instance_id IN
#{instanceId,jdbcType=BIGINT}
SELECT a.inspection_id, a.robot_id, b.robot_name, b.robot_code FROM t_robot_inspection a left join t_robot_info b ON a.robot_id = b.robot_id

SELECT e.device_name as attrName, (CASE WHEN ISNULL(g.mete_name) AND ISNULL(a.inspection_name) THEN '' WHEN ISNULL(g.mete_name) THEN a.inspection_name WHEN ISNULL(a.inspection_name) THEN g.mete_name ELSE CONCAT(g.mete_name,'/',a.inspection_name) END) AS instance_name, f.instance_id FROM t_cruise_point_instance f left join (SELECT DISTINCT device_id,device_name from t_std_device) e on e.device_id = f.device_id left join t_robot_inspection a on f.cruise_id = a.inspection_id left join t_std_devicemete g on f.device_mete_id = g.device_mete_id WHERE f.instance_id in #{instanceId,jdbcType=BIGINT}

SELECT a.robot_id, a.robot_code, a.robot_name, a.robot_status, a.robot_type, b.dict_note AS robotTypeName, a.robot_position, c.dict_note AS robotPositionName, a.phote_path FROM t_robot_info a LEFT JOIN t_dict_business b ON a.robot_type = b.dict_code LEFT JOIN t_dict_business c ON a.robot_position = c.dict_code where 1=1

SELECT DISTINCT e.robot_code FROM t_cruise_task a LEFT JOIN t_cruise_plan_attr b ON a.plan_id = b.plan_id LEFT JOIN t_cruise_point_instance c ON b.instance_id = c.instance_id LEFT JOIN t_robot_inspection d ON c.cruise_id = d.inspection_id LEFT JOIN t_robot_info e ON d.robot_id = e.robot_id where 1=1 and a.task_id = #{taskId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
